title: Even More Worthless Compasses
description: A datapack that adds realistic compasses to the game.
body: This datapack adds Orienteering Compasses, which can be used to tell your direction in degrees. There are three different Orienteering Compasses, one for each dimension. Orienteering Compasses can be crafted with a compass, four iron nuggets, two copper ingots, a glass pane, and a block from thier respective dimension, those being dirt, netherrack, and end stone.
